title: Original design-system component restoration
scope: Shared new-workspace primitives and assigned Deep Dive controls. No workflow/data redesign in this pass.

mappings.implementation: Composes the original KPI CSS module and both exact assets; original gradient, 12px radius, 14px label and 24px semibold value. Parent controls the intended grid layout; original comparison Badge is reused.
White surface, 8px radius, 12px 16px padding, no generic card shadow/border. Original 16px/600/24px section heading and 32px control rhythm; subtitle is compact with full string available as title.

Actual recovered Impact Select, controlled options/current selection, disabled options, portal/outside-close and vendor keyboard handling. NativeDesignSelect parses existing option children and adapts the existing event.target.value handlers. Adapter restores the supplied accessible name on the real vendor combobox.

Actual recovered Impact Input at original large/32px size, native events and aria labels; numeric constraints preserved. Multiline uses the same Impact Input capability. No bespoke gray field chrome is used.

Actual recovered Impact Checkbox, preserving vendor focus/Enter/click behavior and native checked events. Adapter repairs the recovered vendor inputProps overwrite by restoring aria-label on its actual input.
Actual small subtle Impact Badge. No className replaces the vendor styling classes; this was verified against actual rendered markup.

mappings.component: Evidence menu / columns / typed filter popovers
mappings.implementation: Actual recovered Impact Popover and Impact Buttons replace the handcrafted details/positioned-menu surfaces. Checkbox/input/select contents use actual vendor components. Popup allows portal dropdown focus while retaining normal close/focus return.
Actual original ButtonGroup replaces the handcrafted tab strip for local view/presentation controls.
Actual recovered DataGrid throughout. Standard rows/header use original 46px/48px rhythm and 14px grid header text; exact controlled sorting/selection/paging/export semantics are retained.
Composes the original front surface class, original border/radius/shadow and 16px grid rhythm, retaining canonical illustrative flooring images and separate name/image actions.

Original canonical actual/LY colors via seriesColour(0/1): iris #7A5CFF and sky #4BCFFF; original Manrope 12px axes, 13px legend, dashed neutral grid and white 8px tooltip/shadow treatment. No invented gray comparison series.

limits: No Chrome was driven by this agent. Actual viewport/pixel comparison remains root’s native-browser acceptance.
